messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — after launch we need to lock the post-launch plan for customer hotpaths. Customer Z reported streaming latency spikes this morning. Proposal: 2-week 'hotpath' window for critical bugs + one triage groom / week for enhancements. Thoughts? @Jun @Priya
Jun (Eng): Agree on 2-week hotpath. Need to clarify severity cutoffs. Suggest Sev-1 = customer-facing crash/regressions, Sev-2 = latency >200ms p95 on hotpath, others -> backlog. Also recommend a small rapid-fix squad for the window.
Priya (CSE): Customer Z is okay with 2 weeks and wants a dedicated owner for the streaming flow. They asked for a single point of contact for status updates.
Maya (PM): I'll be the point contact for prioritization and customer comms. Jun — can you own hotfix delivery? Ali — can you own infra rollouts? @Ali
Ali (SRE): Yep. We can spin up a tiny Dedicated pool for the hotpath during the window. Need capacity approval + a short runbook (deploy, canary, rollback). I'll draft the runbook and a mitigation checklist today.
Jun (Eng): For backlog grooming I propose a lightweight label set: `hotpath-bug`, `hotpath-req`, `postlaunch-enh`. Triage template to add to issues:
``
- Impact: (customer/internal)
- Severity: Sev-1/2/3
- Repro steps / logs
- Owner
```
I'll open a PR to add the template to the repo.
Priya (CSE): :thumbsup: I'll gate all incoming customer asks into that template before they become tickets. Also FYI — customer asked for a small UX tweak (adjusted pagination) that looks low-risk. Can we bundle into hotfix?
Maya (PM): Low-risk UX tweak can go into hotfix only if it's <4 hours dev and no infra/model change. Anything touching infra or requiring model rollout is out and goes to backlog. Cut-off: by EOD tomorrow we decide hotfix vs backlog.
deploy-bot: deploy started: hotfix/streaming-latency-patch -> staging (build 587).
Jun (Eng): I'll run the perf harness on staging. If p95 drops under 200ms we do a quick canary. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Ali (SRE): I'll stand by to promote canary and watch error/latency dashboards. If errors/regressions >1% during canary we rollback per runbook.
Maya (PM): Action items: Jun — PR with triage template + patch to staging; Ali — runbook + Dedicated pool request; Priya — gate customer asks and confirm UX tweak scope. Meet EOD for final triage. Thanks everyone.
